sources.quote: 4.2 A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that
Correct, the audit qualifies the company. Part approvals stay as they are.

findings.why: The approved supplier list covers PN-050 at PLT-BEI for CUST-AUR, and only SUP-G holds that approval. SUP-C has no entry for PN-050. Its return to approved status on 2026-11-06 qualifies the company only and does not approve it for any part.

sources.quote: 7.1 The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts
7.2 Aurelia shall be notified of every planned change at least 90 days before implementation.

findings.why: PN-050 belongs to PRG-X, which is an Aurelia program. Revision 4 of the Aurelia manual requires written approval (PPAP resubmission) for a change of source, and 90 days' notice. Revision 4 replaces revision 3. No approval or deviation covers this change.

The drawing in force requires 42CrMo4 steel. SUP-C is qualified only for MAT-6061-T6 and MAT-6082-T5, both aluminium, and has no capability for MAT-42CRMO4. The only qualified source is SUP-G (CAP-G-03).

sources.quote: 4.4 A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for

findings.why: There is no EN 10204 3.1 certificate on file from SUP-C for MAT-42CRMO4. Its certificates cover only 6061-T6 and 6082-T5. The supplier quality engineer (PER-GALLO) needs to follow up on this.
